prompt: White fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Streetlamp Glow
irony: White, the mum who fixes everything and cannot switch off, cranks and forces the sleepy lamp, but it only lights when she switches herself off and lets small gentle hands do the soft half-turn.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunset paints the street gold while Green and Navy watch the tall streetlamp stay sleepy.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green quotes his lamp book instead of touching the pole, Navy echoes him, and White arrives hugging her toolbox.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The bulb flickers out as evening tiptoes in, and Black bets White cannot fix the lamp before bedtime.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street sings the streetlamp chant, begging the tall lamp to glow before bedtime.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White climbs and cranks too hard while Green corrects from his book, and the loose bulb stays sleepy.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The ladder wobbles, tools tumble down soft, and White ends up hugging the pole, stuck.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew sings the chant again under the sleepy lamp, hands joined, waiting for the warm glow.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Beneath the sleepy lamp, White admits her fixing fixes nothing and remembers hugs mend Green.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White decides to stop forcing, lifts Navy up, and Green offers his book's soft half-turn trick.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: White sings the turn: she switched herself off and let go, so the lamp and the street glow too.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The lamp glows over the gold street as moths dance and the kids play on in warm light.
